title: Worktree create gives up before a loaded machine finishes the add
why: scripts/worktree-create.sh gives up after BANCHI_WORKTREE_LOCK_WAIT (120 s default, line 65), but under load one `git worktree add` took about 2:40. Reported by Sim Manager 2026-11-23 13:14 CST: 7 of 16 designer spawns timed out in one session, 6 of about 20 in another. The earlier step lane-worktree-add-lock (PR 1033, Nov 4) added the lock and is stale at active.
note: Fix: size the wait to a measured add time, or queue the adds. Related: docs/debts notes lines 44-46. Not measured by triage; the figures are the reporter's.
